name: Goranalli–Narayankhed National Highway
significance: NH 161B is a branch of NH 161. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Goranalli to Narayankhed, and it meets NH 161 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 161 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Sangareddy to Washim
